_about: Wire contract consumed by Milo-Mac (github.com/leodurandfr/Milo-Mac), a SECOND API client beyond frontend/. Milo-Mac is a separate macOS app, not in this checkout, with no API versioning: if the backend drops a route or WS event listed here, Milo-Mac breaks silently at runtime. This manifest is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for that contract. Re-synced 2026-08-30 from the vendored snapshot under vendor/milo-mac/ (MiloAPIService.swift = REST, WebSocketService.swift = WS). test_milo_mac_contract.py enforces TWO things offline on every pytest run: the backend still serves every route/event here, AND this manifest matches the vendored snapshot's surface EXACTLY (so it can't silently drift from the app it protects). The non-blocking CI job check_milo_mac_freshness.py re-clones the real Milo-Mac and warns when the vendored snapshot has fallen behind upstream. Update this file + refresh vendor/milo-mac/ together, CONSCIOUSLY, in one commit when Milo-Mac evolves.

rest.note: Body {volume_db}. The MAC travels WITHOUT colons in the path (dca6327ed343) while every response carries them — Milo-Mac strips them in macForURL(). The backend answers 400 outside the configured limits instead of clamping, so Milo-Mac clamps on its cached limits first.
Body {delta_db} — a zone-wide DELTA the backend applies atomically, emitting a single volume_changed. Milo-Mac deliberately does not loop per-client PATCHes here.

Zone membership comes from here (Client.zone_id / Zone.client_ids); Milo-Mac never reconstructs it from equalizer groups the way frontend/ does. Decoded by MultiroomTopology(json:) in MultiroomModels.swift, which is NOT part of the vendored pair.
Calls the {target} route with the literal target 'local'. The backend route is templated /api/equalizer/target/{target}/enabled.
Single bulk call that replaced the per-category /api/settings/{volume-limits,volume-steps,dock-apps} GET routes. Reads volume_limits.{min_db,max_db} and dock_apps.enabled_apps from the response.
Called with ?favorites_only=true (query string is not part of the path contract).

ws._about: Each (category, type) below MUST have at least one backend emission site: a typed WsEvent subclass (core/models/ws_events.py) referenced outside its defining module. payload_invariants are STATICALLY VERIFIED against those typed models by test_milo_mac_contract.py (test_invariant_* + test_all_payload_invariants_are_verified) — adding/changing an invariant here requires the matching test.

events.note: Emitted as a typed VolumeLimitsChanged event through api/settings.py::_handle_setting_update.

multiroom_changed_discriminator.meaning: boolean sibling of full_state; true marks the authoritative end of a routing transition (multiroom loading spinner completion).

volume_changed.fallback: data.volume_db (Double or Int) when state is absent
volume_changed.multiroom_note: state.clients and state.zones are the ONLY real-time feed for the per-client and per-zone volumes in Milo-Mac's multiroom submenu — no other event carries them. Their contents are decoded by MultiroomVolumes(volumeStateData:) in MultiroomModels.swift, outside the vendored pair, so only the two keys are pinned here.
volume_changed.step_note: step_mobile_db is NO LONGER consumed — Milo-Mac's keyboard step is a local setting (GlobalHotkeyManager.volumeDeltaDb). Do not re-couple to it.

routing/multiroom_error.note: presence only; no payload field is read

multiroom/client_state_changed.note: `client` is ABSENT rather than null when the client leaves the registry (EXCLUDE_NONE), which is exactly what Milo-Mac's optional cast reads as nil. Its contents are decoded by MultiroomClient(json:) outside the vendored pair, so presence only is pinned.

multiroom/zone_changed.note: Milo-Mac reads zone_id, zone, and the PRESENCE of mac_id — it does not read `action`, and derives its member-removed case from `zone == nil && mac_id != nil`. MultiroomZoneChanged's own docstring says that discriminator is wrong: `deleted` carries the zone dict too, so zone-presence says nothing about what happened. Pinned here as what Milo-Mac reads TODAY; the fix belongs in Milo-Mac (branch on `action`), never in a backend shim.

ws.metadata_is_opaque: Milo-Mac reads full_state.metadata as an opaque [String: Any] dict. NO metadata SUB-field is coupled (uri, client_count, album_art_height, track_position/duration, etc.). An over-emitted metadata sub-field with no frontend/src/ consumer is therefore safe to drop without touching this manifest.

consumer_side_only_NOT_enforced.reason: Keepalive; Milo-Mac explicitly ignores it (its tuple switch has no arm for it). Emitted by the WS ping loop, not by broadcast_event(). NOT enforced.
